raw_site_text: participants randomly assigned to one of the 37 states of Nigeria; survey of alumni of a university in a Yoruba-majority state
justification: "The empirical strategy exploits the randomized assignment of NYSC participants to one of the 37 states of the country" and respondents live all across the country.
note: Sample is alumni of one unnamed university (Yoruba-majority state); treatment is posting location across all states, so scored nationwide. Abuja/Lagos/Kano are mentioned only as descriptive context.
